technical_rationale: Requires Java runtime environment and JVM bytecode instrumentation agent (JavaAgent / ASM). SBG sys.settrace engine is Python-specific.
Requires Maven/Ant build systems and JVM bytecode instrumentation.
Requires GCC -finstrument-functions compiler wrapper and POSIX shared memory trace collector.
Competitive programming scripts reading sys.stdin at top level without callable function entry points.
